setup: CREATE TABLE t (id integer, name varchar(20), score integer, grp varchar(10))
CREATE TABLE u (id integer, label text)

cases.sql: select id, score from t order by score desc
select id from t order by score desc limit 1
select id, row_number() over (order by score desc) as rn from t order by id
select string_agg(coalesce(score::text, 'null'), ',' order by score desc) from t
select id, score from t order by score asc
